greetings.text:
Fresh from GitHub.
Still warm.

Volume up.
Worries down.

One more song.
It's never just one.

Headphones on,
world off.

Skip less.
Vibe more.

Plot twist:
the playlist is the main character.

{name} on the decks.
Crowd goes wild.

This greeting isn't an ad.
Neither is the next one.

No ad louder than your song.
Your ears can unclench now.

Want a break from the ads?
Congrats, you found it.

No AI DJ here.
You're the DJ. Act like it.

No family plan asking
for your home address.

We won't sneak songs into your playlist
and call it 'smart'.

No looping video behind your song
eating your battery for fun.

No audiobooks in your music app.
Read like a normal person.

Same song 40 times?
No algorithm to blame this time.

No 'Upgrade' button hiding
behind every other button.

This app has never once
asked for your card.

No 'Made for You' playlist
secretly made for an advertiser.

Your music doesn't stop
when a free trial does.

Built in Assam.
No boardroom approved this greeting.

No shareholders to please.
Just your ears.

No green app judging you.
Just Minim, judging you.

Ad-free from day one.
Not 'first 3 months free'.

'Still listening?'
Obviously. Rude question.

No podcast host
trying to sell you a mattress.

No price hike email coming.
There's no price to hike.

Thappad se darr nahi lagta sahab,
ads se lagta hai.

Tumhare paas premium hai...
Mere paas Minim hai.

Kitne ads the?
Sardar, ek bhi nahi.

Ad pe ad, ad pe ad...
Yahan nahi milega, my lord.

Utha le re baba...
un ads ko, mereko nahi.

Kuch toh gadbad hai, Daya.
Abhi tak ek bhi ad nahi aaya.

Ek baar jo maine skip kar diya,
phir main 'Upgrade' ki bhi nahi sunta.

Minim naam sun ke chhota samjhe kya?
Fire hai main.

Mogambo khush hua.
Aaj ek bhi ad nahi baja.

Premium ka bill dekha?
Moye moye.

Na AI DJ, na algorithm.
Apun hi DJ hai.

Apna time aayega...
bina ad ke.

Free mein background play?
Ye Minim ka style hai.

Bas kar pagle,
kitni baar same gaana bajayega?

Playlist mein kaun tha?
Ad? Nahi. Kabhi nahi.

Picture abhi baaki hai, mere dost.
Ad break nahi.

Jor jor se bolke sabko scheme bata de.
Zero ads, zero bill.

Pushpa, I hate ads.
Isliye Minim.

Ab tera kya hoga, Kaalia?
Premium cancel kar de.

Minim mein ad dhoondhna
mushkil hi nahi, namumkin hai.

How's the josh?
High sir! Zero ads, sir!

Rishte mein toh hum ads ke baap hain.
Naam hai Minim.

Udna chahta hoon, daudna chahta hoon...
bas ad nahi sunna chahta.

Mere Karan Arjun aayenge.
Ads nahi aayenge.

Bhai kya kar raha hai tu?
Bina ad ke gaane sun raha hoon.

I don't judge your music.
I just remember all of it.

Silence is golden.
Gold is overrated. Press play.

Your neighbours called.
They want the bass back.

Warning: may cause
sudden air guitar.

Oh, you're back.
I wasn't waiting. Much.

I saved your spot.
Nobody else was allowed.

Pick a song.
I promise not to tell anyone.

Fun fact: I missed you.
Don't make it weird.

No skips today.
Okay, maybe a few.

I'm not saying you're a DJ.
But you're a DJ.

Your playlist called.
It says it's lonely.

Deep breath.
Now press play.

Shower concert later?
Let's rehearse.

Some people meditate.
You press play.

Today's forecast:
100% chance of bangers.

Go on, hit play.
I dare you.

Every song sounds better
when you pick it.

Look who it is.
My favourite person.

Dance like nobody's watching.
I'm not. Okay, a little.

Bad day?
I have just the song.

Good day?
Let's make it louder.

Your ears deserve this.
Trust me.

I counted.
You need more music today.

Skipping songs is cardio.
Kind of.

Sing along.
The walls won't mind.

I've got songs.
You've got time. Deal?

Ready when you are.
I was born ready.

Music first.
Everything else later.

Nothing playing?
That's a crime in here.

Don't tell the other apps,
but you're my favourite.

Slow day? Fast songs.
Fast day? Also fast songs.

Your taste is great.
Mostly. We'll talk.

Pause the world.
Play the music.

That song in your head?
Let's go find it.

Back so soon?
I'm flattered, honestly.

Your music, your rules.
I just keep the receipts.

I hid the skip button.
Kidding. But think about it.

Speakers ready?
I've been ready for hours.

Life needs a soundtrack.
Luckily, you have me.

{name}! Finally.
The songs were getting bored.

{name}, you're here.
Now the party can start.

Hi {name}.
I kept the speakers warm.
